...The next day, Tokita and the other members of the Film Research Society were found and taken to the hospital.
It seems they'd all been attacked by that creature.
They're still in the hospital even now.
Hm? The creature?
It's been missing since that night.
And no more students at the school have gone missing, either.
I don't know why Tokita and the others weren't eaten.
This is something I heard when I went to visit them, but apparently they've developed something like tumors in their brains.
And I hear the tumors are getting bigger day by day.
What on earth could they be?
But they're doing fine, I hear.
They seem to have healthy appetites, too.
Well, I intend to keep watching to see what happens to them from here on.
That's all I know.
Next person, please.{p}
